description.value: As a bonus action, you can mark one target ship you can see, gaining advantage on any check made to detect, track, or locate it until the end of the encounter. A limited number of times per long rest (equal to your Operator rank), you can use your reaction to subtract the result of a d6 from any attack roll, ability check, or saving throw made by a marked target. This die increases to a d8 at 3rd rank, a d10 at 4th rank, and a d12 at 5th rank.
